text:
Maria G: Hey team — PR #5421 has a tiny rename + gofumpt run. CI passed locally for me but the repo format-hook is failing in one generated file. Can someone give a quick LGTM so we can land before tomorrow's merge window (11:00 PST)?
Samir: looking now. is it a full repo reformat or just a couple files?
Maria G: just two manual files (runtime/kvcache.go, cmd/serve/main.go) + api/zz_gen.go got touched by gofumpt. I didn't intend to change generated code. I ran `gofumpt -w` locally then pushed.
Josh K: ok. sometimes generated files are brittle. @merge-bot can you re-run the format-hook job for #5421?
merge-bot: queued re-run of format-hook for PR #5421 (job 988).
Lee: if api/zz_gen.go is the only generator noise, easiest is to revert that file from this PR and open a tiny follow-up to regenerate correctly. Otherwise patching generated output to match gofumpt is fine too.
Maria G: I can patch the generated file to match gofumpt output and force-push. That keeps the intent. Would that be okay?
Samir: fine with that — keeps the change atomic. Also pinging that we prefer squash for tiny style commits.
Josh K: yep — squash is fine here. I'll do a quick review once format-hook is green.
Maria G: thanks. I'll push a fix in ~5m. Target to land before 10:30 so we don't block the merge window.
merge-bot: format-hook re-run completed — format-hook: failed on api/zz_gen.go (diff).
Maria G: pushed patch to api/zz_gen.go to match gofumpt output, force-pushed.
merge-bot: format-hook re-run queued (job 990).
merge-bot: format-hook: passed. CI: running integration checks.
merge-bot: CI: all checks passed for PR #5421.
Josh K: reviewing now. small nit: can you add a short changelog line in the PR description noting the generator tweak? helps future debugging.
Maria G: done — added "aligned generated file with gofumpt; kept manual rename in kvcache" to the description.
Josh K: LGTM. I'll merge (squash) and watch for any oncall alerts.
Maria G: amazing, thank you! :relieved:
Lee: thanks all. small follow-up: let's add a short note in the dev docs about running `make gen` before formatting to avoid these flakes.
Samir: +1
Josh K: landing now, target merge ~10:20 PST.
merge-bot: PR #5421 merged by Josh K (squash).
